what_happened: The job "Run the test check through pinned cargo-nextest, visibly" (20261025-183644-t67q) failed in the producer stage. The producer made no change. Its report, when sent back, still did not cover the acceptance criteria. Six criteria were unmet or not reported: the decision entry in docs/decisions.md with the measured split and three alternatives; the before-medians wording; the athena.toml nextest pin and the nextest-plus-doctest test check with ATHENA_HOME; the CI workflow install and the CHANGELOG entry; the passing `cargo test --locked` run with the new unit tests; and the clean clippy and fmt runs. The event lists no blocker or major findings and no failed checks. Nothing was delivered.
cause: Nothing before dispatch measures whether a request fits one producer run. This job touches a decision doc, the tool pins in athena.toml, the CI workflow, the check runner's output parsing in checks.rs and gh.rs, new unit tests and the changelog. It also needs a new tool checksum and a real nextest run. The plan size bound is not enforced, and no rule turns a no-change producer into a diagnosed outcome. When the producer finishes with no diff, the system sends back an unmet-criteria list and ends the job, with no reason recorded and no partial plan or split proposal. The closest registered class, producer-makes-no-change-on-archive-restore-job, is limited to docs restores. The deadline class covers timeouts, not a run that ends with no change. This run ended early with no change.
prevention: Add a pre-dispatch size check and a no-change guard for the producer. (1) Before dispatch, count the distinct deliverable surfaces and criteria in the reading, and send any job over a set bound back to be split. (2) If the producer ends with an empty diff, record a stated reason (what it tried, what blocked it, such as an unobtainable checksum or tool) and fail as "no change" with that diagnosis. Do not run the generic unmet-criteria loop. (3) Put the tool pin and checksum step, which needs network access to a real artifact, in its own job ahead of the code job.
proposed_request: Pin cargo-nextest in athena.toml [tools] by exact version and a real checksum, in the same way as the other tools, and add nothing else. The result is that the tool table lists cargo-nextest, the existing config and tools tests pass, and `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` are clean. Do not change the test check, the CI workflow, the docs or the changelog in this job. Follow-up jobs will (a) switch the change and study test check to nextest plus a separate `cargo test --doc` run with no test filtered or ignored, with nextest summary and failing-test parsing in checks.rs and gh.rs and unit tests, and ATHENA_HOME = "{athena_home}" in both capability env tables; (b) install the pinned nextest in .github/workflows/ci.yml, fail loudly on a download or checksum failure, and run nextest and cargo test --doc under the one `test` check; (c) add the docs/decisions.md entry (measured split of compile 67 s and run 673 s on 4 cores, slowest binaries, before-medians of 9.7 min checks, 17.6 min producers and 29 jobs, three alternatives with reasons: sccache per D79, shared target dir, splitting slow tests, and no unmeasured after-number) and the CHANGELOG entry.
